93028c64: What is the name of the dog-devil who merges with Denji?
Pochita, the Chainsaw Devil who looks like a little dog, becomes Denji's heart.
f3250009: Pochita is the Chainsaw Devil, hence the blades that burst out of Denji's body.
732f8c8a: Why does Denji live in poverty at the start of the series?
He has to pay off his father's debts to the yakuza
Denji works as a devil hunter to pay back the huge debt his father left behind.
7e1ebc3f: By pulling a cord in his chest
Denji pulls the starter cord sticking out of his chest, like starting a chainsaw.
a75ca780: How old is Denji at the start of the story?
Denji is 16 when Makima recruits him.
039d98d8: For which organization does Makima recruit Denji?
Makima works for Public Safety's devil hunters.
87e49b3b: Which division is Denji assigned to?
Denji joins Special Division 4, an experimental unit led by Makima.
1f6df5df: Who does Denji share an apartment with?
Denji lives with Aki Hayakawa, his senior, and then Power too, forming an odd little family.
50b63a01: Power is the Blood Fiend: she can create weapons from her own blood.
5e513100: What is the name of Power's cat?
Meowy (Nyako in Japanese) is the only being Power truly cares about at first.
8ba1ac51: Which devil does Aki summon by joining his fingers, making a huge maw appear?
Aki has a contract with the Fox Devil, which appears to devour his targets.
7de71a3f: Which devil, living in Aki's right eye, lets him anticipate attacks?
The Future Devil lives in Aki's eye and loves to repeat that “the future is the best!”.
92f4b8dc: What price does Aki pay to use the Curse Devil?
Each use of the Curse Devil's sword sharply shortens Aki's life expectancy.
56da0e69: To kill the Gun Devil, which killed his family
Aki wants revenge on the Gun Devil, responsible for the death of his family.
f92fb79b: Which huntress, Aki's partner, has a contract with the Ghost Devil?
Himeno, who wears an eyepatch, sacrifices herself during Katana Man's attack.
1d59dcfb: Who trains Denji and Power and is said to be the strongest devil hunter?
Kishibe, a hard-drinking veteran, trains them by killing them over and over thanks to their ability to regenerate.
3825b218: Which nervous but very fast colleague survives Katana Man's attack?
Kobeni Higashiyama, permanently terrified, turns out to be astonishingly fast.
e7721938: What is the name of the young woman Denji meets in a phone booth in the rain?
Reze approaches Denji in a phone booth, at the start of the arc named after her.
0dcc517a: Which devil is Reze a hybrid of?
Reze is the Bomb hybrid, a weapon sent to seize Denji's heart.
91dba090: Where does Reze work when Denji meets her?
Reze works at a café, where Denji comes to see her more and more often.
e4049da9: Beam is the Shark Fiend. He worships Chainsaw Man.
cb25c4ff: What happens when you touch the Angel Devil?
It absorbs part of your lifespan
A mere touch from the Angel Devil drains years of life, making him dangerous even to his allies.
107b188a: Which hybrid, linked to the Crossbow Devil, is known as the first devil hunter?
Quanxi, a killer from China, appears during the international assassins arc.
9bc3372d: A hybrid with a sword-shaped arm and face
Katana Man is the Katana hybrid. He wants to avenge his grandfather, the yakuza boss killed by Denji.
c7cfb74e: Makima is the Control Devil, able to dominate anyone she considers beneath her.
5f6dfd42: A human who turns into a devil
A fiend inhabits the body of a dead person. Power and Beam are two examples.
b9b2f91e: A devil born of two devils
A living human able to transform into a devil
Hybrids stay human and keep their personality. Denji, Reze and Katana Man are hybrids.
3201ad2c: Where does a devil draw its power from?
From the fear its name inspires
From the number of its contracts
The more humans fear what a devil represents, the stronger it is. Universal fears produce the most powerful devils.
9d15d3fd: Where is a devil killed on Earth reborn?
A devil killed on Earth is reborn in hell, and vice versa.
9e0af4d8: Devils embodying ancestral fears that have never been killed
The Primal Devils, like the Darkness Devil, embody ancestral fears and have never known death.
827e29b9: What happens to the concept a devil represents when Chainsaw Man eats it?
It vanishes from the world and from memory
Whatever Chainsaw Man devours ceases to exist, to the point that no one remembers it anymore.
bf8ed8b3: What nickname do devils give Chainsaw Man?
In hell, devils fear and admire him as the Hero of Hell.
3769a1e3: The Bat Devil holds Meowy hostage and pushes Power to hand Denji over.
a7b123a6: Which Primal Devil do the hunters face in hell during the international arc?
The Darkness Devil massacres many of the hunters dragged into hell.
c8d32a32: Why don't attacks against Makima kill her?
A contract with the Prime Minister transfers her wounds to Japanese citizens
Thanks to a contract with the Prime Minister, every wound inflicted on Makima strikes a random Japanese citizen instead.
231e199e: Who kills Denji in the first chapter?
Yakuza allied with the Zombie Devil
The yakuza, who made a pact with the Zombie Devil, betray Denji. Pochita brings him back to life.
6efdc71f: What does Pochita ask of Denji in exchange for his heart?
To show him his dreams and a normal life
Pochita wants Denji to live a normal life and show him his dreams.
54afd11d: What is one of Denji's very first dreams?
To become head of Public Safety
After years of misery, Denji dreams of simple things: bread with jam, a real bed.
788e35ad: In which arc are the hunters trapped on the eighth floor of a hotel?
The Eternity Devil traps the hunters in an endless loop on the eighth floor of a hotel.
ec4733eb: What becomes of Aki at the end of Part 1?
His corpse is taken over by the Gun Devil, becoming the Gun Fiend, and Denji has to fight him.
ebce3550: How does Denji finally beat Makima?
He hands her over to the government
Denji eats her: an act he does not consider an attack, which gets around her protective contract.
fba5d5f8: In what form is the Control Devil reincarnated?
The Control Devil is reborn as a little girl, Nayuta.
5a374e5b: Kishibe entrusts Nayuta to Denji, asking him to raise her differently from Makima.
8e4be418: Who is the main heroine of Part 2?
Asa Mitaka, a lonely high school girl, is the new protagonist of Part 2.
08019823: Which devil shares Asa Mitaka's body?
Yoru, the War Devil, takes over Asa's body to turn her into a weapon.
d994004a: Who is the author of Chainsaw Man?
Tatsuki Fujimoto created Chainsaw Man after Fire Punch.
ee2f73bb: Which long-form manga did Fujimoto publish before Chainsaw Man?
Fire Punch, published from 2016 to 2018, is Fujimoto's first long-form manga.
eb763351: Which of these one-shots is also by Fujimoto?
Look Back, published in 2021, was adapted into an animated film in 2024.
f97716f4: In which magazine was Part 1 published?
Part 1 ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2018 to 2020. Part 2 has been published on Shōnen Jump+ since 2022.
a65fb8c7: How many chapters does Part 1 have?
Part 1, known as the Public Safety arc, ends with chapter 97.
9052cca0: Which studio adapted Chainsaw Man into an anime?
MAPPA produced the series, which aired from October 2022.
f3c8eb0c: Who performs “KICK BACK”, the opening theme?
“KICK BACK” is a song by Kenshi Yonezu.
c052e029: What is special about season 1's ending themes?
They are sung by the voice actors
Every episode has a different ending theme
All 12 episodes have their own ending theme, each performed by a different artist.
ff0a9f5d: Which arc does the film released in 2025 adapt?
The film devoted to the Reze arc came out in Japan in September 2025.
